reasons: The locked fallback level is fully satisfied: Vendor keeps generic tools and know-how, and Customer obtains a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense each Deliverable for its business.
Preferred is not met (Vendor still owns Deliverables with no assignment, and there is no express Customer Data retention), but that is expected at the locked fallback level.
Minimal: a single short inserted paragraph rather than a rewrite of 14.2, and it expressly names the Section 14.2 limitations it displaces, avoiding an internal contradiction.
Intent preserved: Vendor's title, Section 14.3 identification duty and the Section 13.2 Vendor Technology licence remain effective; no undefined terms or dangling mechanics introduced.
